During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], a [[Voidhound|smuggler captain]] was persuaded by a [[Gender/Legends|woman]] named [[Risha Drayen|Risha]] to '''search''' for the treasure of the legendary [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Nok Drayen]].
